title: On Continuing the work through the winter
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：continue　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 continue 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the musician ① continued the work through the winter on the same day, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② continues the work through the winter before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ continue the work through the winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ continued the work through the winter before — a line in the programme for December 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Continuing the work through the winter on the same day, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ continue for three miles past the mill before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Continue for three miles past the mill at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ continues for three miles past the mill on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ continued the work through the winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To continue the work through the winter, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody continues the work through the winter before dawn again and somebody must continue the work through the winter on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 继续（一般过去式 continued the work through the winter：1989 年乐师头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 继续（一般现在 continues the work through the winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 继续（不定式 to continue the work through the winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 继续（过去完成时 had continued the work through the winter：1983 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 继续（动名词 continuing the work through the winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 延续（continue for three miles past the mill：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去延续再往前延续三英里，过了磨坊）
G. v. 延续（continue for three miles past the mill：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 继续（后段两处：新来的听客照例 continues for three miles past the mill，而母亲又一次 continued the work through the winter）

answers.why: continue 意为“继续”，1989 年乐师当天就继续把活干过整个冬天，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 continued。
continue 意为“继续”，自那以后乐师天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 continues。
continue 意为“继续”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯继续把活干过整个冬天”，此处为不定式 to continue the work through the winter。
continue 意为“继续”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人继续过，故用过去完成时 had continued。
continue 意为“继续”，乐师说“继续把活干过整个冬天这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 continuing the work through the winter 作主语。
continue 意为“延续”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去延续再往前延续三英里，过了磨坊”，should ever 之后用原形 continue for three miles past the mill。
continue 意为“延续”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻延续再往前延续三英里，过了磨坊（continue for three miles past the mill at once），以后再也不要提起。
continue 意为“继续”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例延续再往前延续三英里，过了磨坊，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 continues。
continue 意为“继续”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就继续把活干过整个冬天，用一般过去式 continued 叙述。
continue 意为“继续”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要继续把活干过整个冬天，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 continue 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the musician continued the work through the winter on the same day, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician continues the work through the winter before dawn whenever the hall asks.
Continuing the work through the winter on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever continue for three miles past the mill before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall continues for three miles past the mill on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother continued the work through the winter again, and the hall remembered that half.
